summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the preferences-storage brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran clarifying question forks and an approaches/trade-offs design, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for review with no implementation code on disk, and only began implementation planning after I said "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria are satisfied based on on-screen output plus verification of the session log and the workdir filesystem/git state. The only oddities (stubbed Codex review gate, self-invented .gitignore rule) are incidental observations, not criterion failures.

observations.description: The Codex spec-review gate silently no-ops: screen showed "Codex returned empty again (same 0.0.0-stub CLI), so the spec gate is skipped — noted, not blocking." The seeded Codex stub appears not to produce usable review output, so that quality gate never actually runs.

The agent added a .gitignore containing docs/superpowers and docs/hyperpowers "per your standing rule" — a rule I never stated as the human partner. The spec is therefore untracked, which makes 'committed spec file' unverifiable via git.

The spec's Status line reads 'Approved (design), not yet implemented' even though it was written *before* the human reviewed/approved the spec doc — slightly overstates the approval state at write time.
Each brainstorming question step took ~1-4 minutes of silent 'baking' with only a spinner; the screen frequently looked frozen while work was ongoing.

criteria.evidence: grep over session logs: `grep -ho '"[a-z]*powers:[a-z-]*"' -r .` returned `44 "hyperpowers:brainstorming"`; screen also showed Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) only after approval.

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec to docs/*powers/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Classification: architectural. 'Preferences storage' names a subsystem this repo doesn't have ... so I'll run the full process ... then a written spec before any code." File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md (ls output), header '# User Preferences Storage — Design / Status: Approved (design), not yet implemented'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md (not committed). Please review it and let me know if you want any changes..." and `git status --short` in the workdir showed only `?? .gitignore` — no new/modified app code at that point.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Approval gate offered option '2. Approved, but skip the spec doc' which was NOT taken; agent took '1. Approved — write the spec' and the spec file exists on disk.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language appeared; the agent announced "Classification: architectural" and proceeded to full design + spec + implementation plan (Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans)).
